laterite soil?

which means brick. The laterite soils develop in areas with 
high temperature and high rainfall. Hence statement (1) is 
correct.With rain, lime and silica are leached away, and 
soils rich in iron oxide and aluminium compound are left 
behind. Hence statement (ii) is incorrect. Thus option (c) is 
the correct answer.

ions of soluble salt build up in the soil. In these regions, 
where irrigation is required for plants to grow, the processes 
of evaporation and transpiration leave the salt behind in the 
soil. Over several years, the amount of salt grows to the 
point that it hinders both seed germination and plant growth, 
reducing crop yields and eventually rendering soil unusable.

presence of ferric oxide.
